title: Smoky Mitsuba Skewers with Polish Sausage
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make skewer recipe featuring smoky polish sausage, mitsuba, and a hint of smokiness.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread polish sausage and mitsuba leaves onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until sausage is cooked through.
Brush with unforgettable balsamic glaze during the last minute of grilling.
Let skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve with additional balsamic glaze on the side, if desired.
Repeat as needed for additional servings.
